title: Hephaestus
summary: Hephaestus is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.date: “who reigned 724 and a half years and four days”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 111; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 19, and Eusebius, Chronicle 7
reign.note: First of the Egyptian kings in this list. The text adds (Vulcan).

reign.date: “To Hephaestus [or, Vulcan] is assigned no time”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 136; Old Egyptian Chronicle, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 51, and Eusebius, Chronicle 6
reign.note: The dynasty list (p. 111) gives Hephaestus 724 and a half years and four days. Both statements are kept.
